{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of the 'organic' channel
print(sales['channel'].unique())

# Check the revenue column for thousands separators
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")"}
